name: Wisconsin DECA chapters and state conference
org: Wisconsin DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at your school and build business and marketing skills. Chapters compete at the Wisconsin state conference in Lake Geneva.
who_can_apply: Wisconsin DECA strongly encourages members to also be enrolled in a marketing or business course. Chapters need an advisor with a marketing or business educator license. Detailed rules are not listed.
pay_detail: $18 per student member: $10 to the state association plus $8 to DECA Inc. Local chapter fees are not stated.
deadline_text: The Wisconsin DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 in Lake Geneva, WI. No membership deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's business or marketing teacher about a DECA chapter. For eligibility and deadlines, contact the Wisconsin DECA advisor, Tim Fandek, at Timothy.Fandek@dpi.wi.gov.
notes: Not a paid job. The state website listed on the page is wideca.org. This card is based on the DECA Inc. page for Wisconsin.
